newsitem.title: UK: Swiss Re's Uniorias buy positive - Salomon.
newsitem.headline: Swiss Re's Uniorias buy positive - Salomon.

text.p: Swiss Re's acquisition of Italian reinsurer Uniorias last week is a useful complement to the company's growth strategy at an undemanding price and the shares remain a buy, Salomon Brothers said.

"We expect the new CEO to continue implementing the company's strategic and cultural changes, and to remain focused on shareholder value. The shares' valuation still leaves considerable upside potential," the broker said in a note.
Walter Kielholz will become chief executive of Swiss Re when Lucas Muehlemann moves to Credit Suisse on January 1, 1997.
Salomon expects the group to show earnings growth of more than 20 percent in 1996 and is optimistic about the prospects for 1997 and 1998.
The stockbroker forecasts that Swiss Re's shares will reach 1,650 francs in the next 12 months, compared with the current 1,398.
